subject: Procurement readiness + MAP check-in (AcmeCloud)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: John D. <john.doe@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & next steps  - procurement path + MAP (AcmeCloud)

Hi John  - great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum on procurement.

Call highlights:
- Use case: intent-based search + summarization in internal agent workflows. Expected peak qps ~ 30, average latency target < 300ms.
- Integrations: will need SSO (SAML) and KMS integration for keys at rest.
- Evaluation: pilot expected in prod-like environment, 2-3 week POC.

Commercial / procurement items to confirm:
1) Procurement vehicle: do you plan to buy via PO (Finance-driven) or use card/company purchasing? Any interest in procuring via AWS Marketplace?
2) Contracting: legal review required? If so, estimated review timeline? Do you have any bespoke terms (privacy addendum, data residency)?
3) Security evidence: SOC 2 + pen test report  - we can share a redacted bundle.

Proposed mutual action plan (attached as Redwood-MAP-v2.xlsx):
- Week 1 (Mar 18-24): Share SOC2 bundle + technical SSO/KMS questionnaire answers.
- Week 2 (Mar 25-31): Legal review + security review begin.
- Week 3 (Apr 1-7): Finance review; PO issuance if legal ok.
- Week 4 (Apr 8-14): Onboarding kickoff / dedicated capacity prep.

Ask: can you confirm the procurement vehicle and whether legal needs to own contract review? If PO, any PO template we should expect?

I'll follow up with Marcus and Camila for any contract or security artifacts you want from our side.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-v2.xlsx (MAP draft)

From: John D. <john.doe@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmecloud.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps  - procurement path + MAP (AcmeCloud)

Thanks Marissa  - good summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Procurement vehicle: Finance prefers PO for any vendor > $25k ARR. This will go through our central procurement team. So likely PO + net-30 terms.
2) Marketplace: We prefer direct vendor contract for this engagement (do not need AWS marketplace).
3) Legal & security: Legal will need to review contract  - estimate 10 business days once they receive the draft. Security will require SOC 2 Type II and a short questionnaire; they may request an architecture readout.

Timeline note: If legal takes 10 business days starting Mar 25, and finance needs 3-5 business days after legal sign-off, PO issuance looks like mid-April unless we can compress legal review. We'll keep you posted.

Also looping in Priya (IT procurement)  - Priya, can you confirm finance owner and any required PO templates?

Best,
John
Principal Product Manager, Platform
AcmeCloud

On Thu, Mar 19, 2026 at 09:15 AM Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmecloud.com> wrote:
> Hi all  - Priya here. Finance owner is Lara Chen (l.chen@acmecloud.com). Our standard PO runs net-30.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: John D. <john.doe@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 10:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps  - procurement path + MAP (AcmeCloud)

Appreciate the clarity, John  - that's helpful. Quick follow-up items from our side: 

- We'll send a redacted SOC 2 bundle and a short answers doc for the security questionnaire by EOD Tue (attached SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf).
- Marcus, can you prepare a contract draft (standard MSA + SOW) that aligns with net-30 PO terms? If legal wants redlines, we can handle them directly with AcmeCloud legal.
- Camila, I'll flag onboarding start dates scoped for mid-April assuming PO issuance by then.

If legal needs faster turnaround, we can offer a 1-week expedited review with our legal team prioritization  - would that help?

Thanks  - I'll wait to hear if Priya / Lara share any PO template or timeline changes.

Regards,
Marissa

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: John D. <john.doe@acmecloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MSA + SOW (for legal)

John / Marissa  - attaching an initial draft MSA + SOW that assumes PO payment and net-30 terms. Key callouts are:
- Data protections: standard Redwood DPA language included in Exhibit A.
- KMS integration: ops runbook in SOW section 3.2.
- Term/termination: 12-month MSA with 30-day termination for convenience.

If AcmeCloud legal has specific clauses, we can prepare tracked changes. Marissa  - I flagged the SLA language to be conservative; happy to relax depending on customer needs.

Next steps: John, if you can share the PO template or confirm any mandatory clauses (e.g., indemnity caps), we'll incorporate them and send back for review.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood-MSA-v1.docx

From: John D. <john.doe@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MSA + SOW (for legal)

Thanks Marcus  - this looks good as a starting point. A few items from legal that I flagged this morning: 
- Indemnity cap: legal will ask for a mutual cap; they typically accept lesser of $1M or 12 months' fees.
- Data residency: must include option to keep logs in us-east-1 only.
- PO template: attaching our PO sample (sent offline by Priya).

We remain aligned on PO path. Timeline update: legal confirmed they can start review as soon as they receive the MSA + SOW (they aim for 10 business days but will prioritize if we confirm expedited request). Finance (Lara) will process PO within 3 business days of signed MSA.

I'll aim to have initial redlines in by Apr 2, which would keep us on track for mid-April PO issuance.

Best,
John

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: John D. <john.doe@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement readiness + MAP check-in (AcmeCloud)

Perfect  - thanks for the quick turnaround, team. Next steps summary from Redwood: 
- Today: Marcus uploaded Redwood-MSA-v1.docx to the thread. Marissa to send SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf.
- By Apr 2: AcmeCloud legal to provide initial redlines (per John).
- Apr 3-6: Redwood to respond to legal redlines and confirm any negotiated clauses.
- Apr 7-9: Finance (AcmeCloud) to issue PO (target mid-April).

I'll set up a 30-min check-in for Apr 6 to confirm PO status and onboarding dates  - proposed: Tue Apr 6, 10:00 AM PT. Let me know if that works and I'll send a calendar invite.

Appreciate the partnership  - we'll make the legal/Security packet as easy as possible.

Cheers,
Marissa
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
